editor.loadFailed_other: {{count}} tracks couldn't be loaded and are left out.
editor.batchHint_one: Editing {{count}} track. Fields showing “Multiple values” keep each track’s own value unless you type a new one.
editor.batchHint_other: Editing {{count}} tracks. Fields showing “Multiple values” keep each track’s own value unless you type a new one.
editor.discardDescription: Your edits haven't been written to the files yet.

rebuild.description: Rainy will read the existing tags first, rebuild each file through TagLib, and rescan it. For WAV files with unreadable legacy INFO tags, those bytes are kept as an inert chunk. Review your library backup before changing files.

cover.dropHint: Drop or paste an image here.
cover.hasEmbedded: This file has an embedded cover.
cover.noEmbedded: No embedded cover — showing the album artwork.
cover.embeddedCount: {{count}} of {{total}} files have an embedded cover.
cover.scopeAlbumDisabled: Whole album (select tracks of one album)
cover.saveToFolder: Also save as the folder image (cover.jpg)
cover.nothingSelected: Choose at least one place to save the cover.
cover.removeFolderImage: Also move the folder image (cover.jpg …) to the trash

lyrics.label: Lyrics
lyrics.embeddedHint: Stored inside the audio file (LYRICS tag).
lyrics.lrcHint: Stored next to the audio file as a .lrc sidecar — best for synced lyrics.
lyrics.placeholder: Paste lyrics here. Use [mm:ss.xx] timestamps for synced lyrics.
lyrics.stampHint: Put the current playback time at the start of the current line and move to the next line.
lyrics.playToStamp: Play this track to insert timestamps.
lyrics.singleOnly: Lyrics can be edited for one track at a time.
lyrics.bilingualPairedHint: Lines with the same timestamp are shown as original and translation.
lyrics.bilingualDetected_one: {{count}} line looks like bilingual lyrics (original, a space, then the Chinese translation).
lyrics.bilingualDetected_other: {{count}} lines look like bilingual lyrics (original, a space, then the Chinese translation).
lyrics.bilingualTimedHint: Split them into two lines with the same timestamp: the standard bilingual LRC layout that Rainy and most Subsonic apps show as original plus translation.
lyrics.bilingualPlainHint: The player already shows them as original and translation. Add timestamps first to split them into standard bilingual LRC.
lyrics.bilingualDone_one: Split {{count}} line into original and translation.
lyrics.bilingualDone_other: Split {{count}} lines into original and translation.

raw.hint: Every tag stored in the files. Keys use TagLib names (TITLE, ARTIST, …); empty keys are removed on save.
raw.invalidKey: Use letters, digits, spaces and _ : . - / (lyrics are edited in the Lyrics tab).

errors.noTokens: The pattern needs at least one field token like {title}.
errors.noMatch: File name doesn't match the pattern

autoNumber.title: Auto-number tracks
autoNumber.description: Number the selected tracks in order, starting again for every album.

fromFilename.title: Tags from file name
fromFilename.description: Read tag values out of the file names.
fromFilename.tokens: Tokens: {title} {artist} {album} {albumartist} {track} {disc} {year} {genre} {composer} {ignore}. Use / to include folder names.

replace.title: Find & replace
replace.description: Replace text in a field of every selected track.

copy.title: Copy field
copy.description: Copy one field's value into another.
copy.onlyEmpty: Only where the target is empty

clear.title: Clear field
clear.description: Remove a field from every selected track.

online.title: Search online
online.description: Find tags, cover and lyrics in online music catalogues. Nothing is saved until you save in the editor.
online.enterQuery: Enter a title, artist or album to search.
online.noResultsHint: Try fewer words or another catalogue.
online.providerFailed: {{provider}} didn't answer. Try again, or search another catalogue.
online.lengthMismatch: The length differs from this track by more than 10 seconds.
online.applied: Filled in — review the changes and save.
online.batchHint: Editing several tracks: only album-level fields are offered. Title, artist and track numbers are filled one track at a time.
online.disabledAdmin: Turn on “Online metadata lookup” in Admin → Settings. Searches then send the search terms to the chosen catalogue.
online.disabledManager: An administrator can turn on online metadata lookup in the server settings.

readonly.title: These files are read-only
readonly.description: Rainy can't write to the music folder. If it runs in Docker, mount the music volume without “:ro” and make sure the container user (PUID/PGID) can write to it.
readonly.short: The music folder is read-only — check the volume mount and permissions.

table.noResultsDescription: Try a different search or remove some filters.
table.emptyDescription: Upload music or add a library folder, then scan it.
table.tooManyToEdit_one: The tag editor can open at most {{max}} tracks at once. Narrow the filters or selection.
table.tooManyToEdit_other: The tag editor can open at most {{max}} tracks at once. Narrow the filters or selection.

selection.hint: Click to select · Shift or Ctrl/⌘ to add · double-click to edit

delete.description_one: The file is moved to Rainy's trash. You can restore it from Trash until it is emptied.
delete.description_other: The files are moved to Rainy's trash. You can restore them from Trash until it is emptied.

rename.title: Rename & organize
rename.description_one: Move {{count}} file to a path built from its tags.
rename.description_other: Move {{count}} files to paths built from their tags.
rename.help: “/” creates folders, […] is dropped when its tokens are empty, the extension is kept. Lyrics (.lrc) move along.

encoding.title: Fix text encoding
encoding.descriptionAll: Repair garbled (mojibake) tags in every track the library doctor flagged.
encoding.hint: Tags written in GBK, Big5 or Shift-JIS by old software often look like “ÄãºÃ”. Review the repairs, then write them to the files.
encoding.noneDescription: No garbled tags were detected in these tracks.

coverDialog.title: Cover art
coverDialog.removeHint: Embedded pictures will be removed from the selected files.

upload.title: Upload
upload.subtitle: Add music from this device to the library.
upload.invalidDir: The folder can't contain “.” or “..” segments.
upload.folderOrganizeHint: Organized files are placed under this folder.
upload.organizeHint: Place files automatically using the rename pattern:
upload.dropHint: Audio files only (covers and lyrics are edited in the tag editor). Folder structure is kept.
upload.audioOnly: Only audio files can be uploaded.

folders.subtitle: Browse the files on disk.
folders.emptyDescription: Upload music into it, or pick another folder.

doctor.title: Library doctor
doctor.subtitle: Find and fix common library problems.
doctor.pick: Choose a check above to see details.
doctor.purgeAllDescription_one: {{count}} track whose file no longer exists will be removed from the database (with its plays and favorites). Files on disk are not touched.
doctor.purgeAllDescription_other: {{count}} tracks whose files no longer exist will be removed from the database (with their plays and favorites). Files on disk are not touched.

missing_tags.title: Missing tags
missing_tags.description: Tracks without title, artist or album.
missing_tags.help: These tracks fall back to file names or “Unknown” in players.

no_cover.title: No cover
no_cover.help: Add an embedded cover or a folder image (cover.jpg).

duplicates.title: Duplicates
duplicates.description: The same song more than once.
duplicates.help: Tracks with the same title, artist and duration. Keep the best copy and move the rest to the trash.

missing_files.title: Missing files
missing_files.help: The file was moved or deleted outside Rainy. Rescan to pick up moves, or remove the entries.

encoding.title: Encoding
encoding.description: Garbled tags with broken character encoding.
encoding.help: Tags that look like GBK / Big5 / Shift-JIS read as Latin-1 (mojibake).

trash.title: Trash
trash.subtitle: Deleted files can be restored until the trash is emptied.
trash.selectHint: Select files to restore or delete
trash.emptyDescription: Files you delete in Rainy show up here.
trash.emptyConfirmDescription_one: {{count}} file will be deleted permanently. This can't be undone.
trash.emptyConfirmDescription_other: All {{count}} files will be deleted permanently. This can't be undone.
trash.deleteConfirmDescription: They will be removed from disk permanently. This can't be undone.

history.title: Edit history
history.subtitle: Every change Rainy made to your files.
